image_description: A close-up view of a black, dual-lens jeweler's loupe (likely a triplet or doublet design) resting on a white background. The device features two circular lens housings connected by a central body. The left lens shows significant reflection and distortion typical of high-magnification glass. The right side appears to have a protective cover or a second lens element. White text is visible on the top surface of the right housing.
